display_name: OWASP ASVS Universe Projection into the Applicability Request (ADR-0034)
validation_rules: the newest accepted, within-budget 04-owasp-universe and its T03 admission are hash and pointer bound
every ASVS chapter target is projected exactly once as asvs-V<n> with control_scope {domain_ids: [V<n>]} (17 components; owasp-component-routing/2.0)
each chapter rule carries the universe decision: participating is applicable with its participant bundle, not_applicable cites the universe reason, a gap stays cannot_determine with a visible gap
selected-control by chapter target count is explicit
no keyword, component-map or model output decides a target, an applicability or a budget
